summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in run() (cleared on every exit path). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 7 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable, exception propagation, exit value, and call-after-stop; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src. The 68 failures in the wider suite also occur on the untouched base checkout, so they predate this change (the venv appears to lack pytest-asyncio; aiohttp is also missing for tests/devtools and tests/cli). No commit was made.
